_about: Signature showcase subjects for the style test (research 'Style test showcase prompts', 2026-10-30): the composition, light and subject each style is known for, with a channel story beat inside. One subject doing one thing, trait words only, no names, no signs, labels or quoted words. Styles not listed here get a subject drafted once by the local AI (saved in the data folder, editable in Test styles).

subjects.relief_print: A town crier mid-stride rings a hand bell while a black crow carries the rumour from chimney to chimney above the stacked rooftops of a small hill town, seen from a low angle, the crier large on the left third, the sky made of radiating gouge lines, flat graphic light, brick red only on the crow and the bell
subjects.fingerprint_clay_stop_motion: A plasticine shopper on a tiny kitchen set weighs one giant lumpy clay tomato on a toy scale, eyebrows raised in doubt, warm practical lamp light from the side, macro view with shallow focus, felt curtains and cardboard cupboards behind
subjects.backlit_shadow_puppet_fable: A lace-cut black silhouette messenger in strict profile whispers into a giant flower shaped like an ear, the whisper drawn as a trail of cut-paper birds flying away across a glowing amber gradient
subjects.fog_layer_glass_fable: A small traveller with a lantern stands lost in milky fog between layered pine trees, one warm window glowing far away, cold moonlight from the left, the trees fading into paler layers with distance
subjects.noir: A figure in a trench coat under a single streetlamp in a rain-slick alley hands a plain envelope to a second shadowed figure, venetian-blind shadows striping a brick wall, hard light from above, wet cobbles shining
subjects.comic: A low-angle panel of an invented square-jawed hero bursting through a giant torn sheet of blank newsprint, speed lines radiating outward, halftone dots in the shadows, an empty jagged starburst shape behind him
subjects.old_world_string_marionette: A carved wooden salesman marionette bows on a tiny painted stage, his strings rising up into darkness to a pair of huge hands, a single warm footlight from below, velvet curtains half drawn
subjects.floating_world_woodblock: A great curling wave made of blank paper sheets rises over a small boat of people seen from behind, a distant mountain under a pale sky, bold diagonal crop, flat colour gradients
subjects.victorian_toy_theatre: A card-cut paper stage with layered painted wings, a striped hot-air balloon rising before a crowd of cut-out spectators seen from behind, candle-like footlights glowing along the front edge
subjects.blueprint: An exploded view of a miracle water filter, its unlabelled parts floating apart around an empty hollow box, crisp white technical lines on deep Prussian blue, measured guide lines and circles
subjects.constructivist_agitprop_poster: A giant loudspeaker on a steep diagonal tower blasts a storm of blank paper leaflets over a crowd seen from behind, hard geometric shapes, a bold red diagonal slicing the sky
subjects.documentary: A period kitchen table with an old wooden radio, a family seen from behind leaning in to listen, soft window light, dust floating in the beam, worn wallpaper
subjects.classroom: An empty classroom in golden afternoon light, a green chalkboard covered in chalk arrows and circles linking a jar of coins to a radio, wooden desks in rows, a globe on the teacher's table
subjects.cartoon: A cheerful flat cartoon town where a single rumour, drawn as a bright paper aeroplane, zig-zags from rooftop to rooftop past round trees, everyone below seen from behind pointing up at it
subjects.satire: An invented grinning salesman in an oversized checked suit pours a stream of gold coins from a bottle into his own hat while a line of tiny townspeople wait below, loose ink lines and a light watercolour wash
subjects.newscast: A retro television news studio at night with an empty anchor desk, a big glowing world globe behind it, blue and gold studio light, a camera on a tripod in the foreground, every screen showing plain colour
subjects.truecrime: A cork evidence board lit by one desk lamp, red string linking blank photographs turned face down, plain index cards and a map with pins, a coffee cup ring on the desk below
subjects.courtroom: A wood-panelled courtroom seen from the gallery, the judge's bench high and empty, lawyers seen from behind leaning over their tables, loose pastel strokes and charcoal shadows, warm overhead light
subjects.papercut: A layered paper town at dusk where a paper megaphone on a hill sends rings of cut-paper sound waves over the rooftops, soft drop shadows between the layers, a big paper moon
subjects.infomercial: A bright retro studio kitchen set with a gleaming miracle blender on a turntable, a cheering studio audience seen from behind, starburst shapes of plain colour, blazing studio lights
subjects.heist: A blueprint spread across a table under a hanging lamp, four gloved hands moving toy markers around a vault, teal shadows and warm orange light, a split panel showing a ticking wall clock
